title: Asteroid Collision
summary: Objects appear from left to right in the listed order.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned ints.

statement: Objects appear from left to right in the listed order. Positive values move right and negative values move left, all at equal speed. Their absolute values are sizes. When two meet, the smaller disappears. Equal sizes both disappear. Return the surviving signed values in their original relative order.

examples.explanation: The 2 disappears, then the 4 defeats the incoming 3.
These objects move away from each other.

hints: Conceptual: Only a right-moving object followed by a left-moving object can collide.
Directional: Keep the surviving prefix in a stack.
Implementation: For a new negative value, repeatedly resolve collisions with a positive stack top before deciding whether the new value survives.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary stack space.
